headline: Executive order signed in 2020 that addresses how online platforms limit or remove what users post.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with concerns that online platforms block, remove, or limit users' speech. It directs action by the federal government on this issue. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Online platforms such as social media companies
who_it_affects.how: The order appears aimed at how these companies moderate or remove content that users post.

who_it_affects.group: People who post content on social media and other websites
who_it_affects.how: The order concerns how their posts may be limited or removed by the platforms they use.
